subject: Future Tech
title: The History of Fusion Research
description: A micro-lesson that makes The History of Fusion Research usable.

hook.text: In 1958, the US, UK, and USSR all declassified their fusion research simultaneously. The race to tame the sun began.

buildup.text: Early optimism was huge. Scientists predicted fusion power within 20 years. Governments funded massive programs.

discovery.text: The problem was plasma: superheated gas at 100 million degrees that destroys any container.

twist.text: Decades passed without a breakthrough. Funding dried up. Fusion became a punchline, not a priority.

climax.text: Private companies entered after 2010, bringing Silicon Valley speed. Over $6 billion flowed into fusion startups.

punchline.text: 70 years of 'almost there' may finally be ending.

quiz.question: Why was fusion research so difficult in the early decades?
